slides.headline: Before you buy another AI tool, look here first.

slides.label: THE MISTAKE
slides.wrong_sub: Another login. Another bill. Another thing to learn.
slides.right:
Look for the AI
button first.
slides.right_sub: Many apps have one. Plans differ.

slides.label: App 1
slides.title: Email and docs
slides.card: Summarize this thread in 3 bullets. List what I still owe each person.
slides.note: Look for the AI or sparkle button.

slides.label: App 2
slides.title: Meetings
slides.card: Turn this transcript into 3 decisions, tasks with owners and a short follow-up email.
slides.note: Check if your video app has recaps.

slides.label: App 3
slides.title: Spreadsheets
slides.card: Which rows look unusual in this table? Explain each in one sentence.
slides.note: Check every number before you act.

slides.label: App 4
slides.title: Notes and wikis
slides.card: List everything we decided about [client] and what is still open.
slides.note: Keep private notes out of it.

slides.label: App 5
slides.title: Design
slides.card: Make 3 versions of this graphic: Instagram post, story and LinkedIn banner.

scenes.title: THE AI STEP
scenes.label: COPY THIS
scenes.text: Read this document. Reply with only a file name: YYYY-MM-DD_Company_Type. Types: Invoice, Contract, Quote, Brief. If you're unsure about any part, write CHECK.

scenes.note: Test on 10 files first. Skip anything private.
scenes.text: Send this to someone who lives in Downloads.
